Names are Dr. Schreiner's own product names (price-list page §5), labels are the navigation labels from architecture v6. Scales, coefficients, sample items, citations and sampling minimums are CLIENT-SUPPLIED facts: null here means 'awaiting Dr. Schreiner' and the page renders a pending block, never a placeholder number. instruments.label: Undergraduate
instruments.name: Undergraduate Thriving Quotient
instruments.capsule: The Undergraduate Thriving Quotient is a validated survey instrument that measures how far undergraduate students are thriving — engaged academically, connected interpersonally, and psychologically well. Every factor it measures is malleable: an institution can act on the results.
instruments.measures: the undergraduate Thriving Quotient measures student thriving across academic engagement, interpersonal connection and psychological wellbeing, on scales that institutions can move through their own practice.
instruments.description: The Thriving Quotient undergraduate instrument: what it measures, its scales, how administration works, sample items, and what a campus survey costs.

scales.name: Engaged Learning
scales.def: The degree to which a student is energised by, and invested in, the act of learning itself.

scales.name: Academic Determination
scales.def: Goal-directed effort, self-regulation and persistence toward academic aims.

scales.name: Positive Perspective
scales.def: An optimistic explanatory style and the capacity to take a longer view of setbacks.

scales.name: Diverse Citizenship
scales.def: Openness to difference and a sense of responsibility toward the wider community.

scales.name: Social Connectedness
scales.def: The presence of meaningful relationships and a felt sense of belonging on campus.

instruments.label: Faculty
instruments.name: Faculty Thriving Quotient
instruments.capsule: The Faculty Thriving Quotient is a validated survey instrument that measures thriving among faculty members — the people whose own engagement and wellbeing shape every student outcome the other instruments measure. Its scales are stated by Dr. Schreiner and appear here once confirmed.
instruments.measures: the Faculty Thriving Quotient measures faculty thriving on validated scales that institutions can act on through their own practice.
instruments.description: The Faculty Thriving Quotient: what it measures among faculty members, its scales, how administration works, and what a campus survey costs. Adjunct faculty option available.
instruments.notes:
Adjunct faculty

An adjunct faculty version is administered as a variant of this instrument. It is not a separate page or product: choose Adjunct Faculty Thriving Quotient as the instrument at checkout.
